entities.summary: Haim Saban is an Israeli and American media proprietor, investor, musical composer and producer of records, film, and television. A businessman with interests in financial services, entertainment, and media, he has an estimated net worth of $3.3 billion. Saban is the founder of Saban Entertainment, producer and distributor of children's television programs in the US such as Power Rangers. He headed up consortiums which purchased the broadcasters ProSiebenSat.1 Media and Univision Communications. He is a major donor to the United States Democratic Party and active in pro-Israel political efforts in the United States.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Haim Saban's investments in media and entertainment have had a significant impact on children's television programming in the US, with his company Power Rangers being a major player. His net worth of $3.3 billion reflects his substantial influence in the global entertainment industry.
